enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +32: Passive: +32 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Power of the Firestorm +158: Passive: +158 Equipment bonus to Fire and Electric Spell Power.
Efficient Metamagic - Embolden II: The additional spell point cost for using the Embolden Metamagic feat is reduced by 2 SP.
Efficient Metamagic - Intensify II: The additional spell point cost for using the Intensify Metamagic feat is reduced by 2 SP.

Greater Elemental Spell Power: Harnessing a small amount of the power and potential of the raw elements, this item gives you a +100 bonus to your maximum spell points. This stacks with all other bonuses except Greater Elemental Spell Power.
Planar Searing: This weapon harbors a burn unlike anything you've ever seen - As if otherworldly power has started to change it forever.

Legendary Forbidden Knowledge: 3 Pieces Equipped:+30 Profane bonus to PRR4 Pieces Equipped:+3 Profane bonus to all ability scores+4 Profane bonus to attack and damage5 Pieces Equipped:+15 Profane bonus to Melee and Ranged Power+25 Profane bonus to Universal Spell Power+3 Profane bonus to Spell DCs
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
